## Summary

What does this PR change?

## Type

- [ ] feat — new tool or capability
- [ ] fix — bug fix
- [ ] docs — README/CHANGELOG only
- [ ] chore — deps, CI, build

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] Tool inputs validated with zod (`.describe()` on every field)
- [ ] README tools table updated (if a tool was added/renamed)
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated under `## [Unreleased]`
